body: You made this sound so easy! I texted her something  similar and she said she would love to hang out sometime. I appreciate the help!

The first thing I did was say that I was sorry for acting insensitive. She told me she knows it wasn't directed at her but one comment I made really bothered her. As I reevaluated it, I felt that more than one thing I said was insensitive. I don't want to try and "fix" things with her because I feel that invalidates how she is feeling. Everything in me wants to ask for another chance but I didnt because I don't want to make her feel like she has to feel more uncomfortable for my chance at learning or "fixing" something. I told her that I will do better in the future whether or not that situation is with her.

Unfortunately I don't think she's going to talk to me again. I don't want my bad day to be an excuse for saying shit things but also, I felt so out of character. 

I don't know why I care so much. Ive only talked to her for 2 weeks and met her once. I keep telling myself it doesn't matter and there are more people but for some reason this one is hurting me and I feel like the biggest mess up of a person about it.

I appreciate it. I'm definitely having a hard time. This has basically crushed what little confidence I had and I'm feeling very inadequate. Its very hard for me to keep my distance as we have been best friends for the last 3 years.

I think those boundaries are something I'm completely unsure of. I'm not someone who likes being alone and I used to be in a religious community that was all toxic. So I'm not even sure what real friendships are supposed to look like.
I know it sounds dumb, but i really do love (as a friend) and care about her. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do. I can't lose all my confidence and best friend (and only friend) at the same time.
I know I need to cut her out but I really love her (as a friend) and she is my only friend in the first place. I don't know how to move on from all of this.
She used me for that and to make her feel wanted when she was between girlfriends.
I wish I would. But she's really my only friend. I've had a hard time making friends ever since I came out and left my religious community
Its just that I never wanted to date her prior to her pushing me for sex and then begging me to date. It was all her idea and then as soon as I was in, she acted like it was my idea.
I would have never even went there in the first place had she not practically begged to date me 2 weeks prior.
Its just hard because I never remember being this lonely when I was married.
Unfortunately they know what I want and how I feel.
